title: Euro 2012: Mario Balotelli scores twice in 2-1 Italian win - CBS News
content: # Euro 2012: Mario Balotelli scores twice in 2-1 Italian win. Image 1: WARSAW, POLAND - JUNE 28: Mario Balotelli of Italy controls the ball as he runs through to score his team's second goal during the UEFA EURO 2012 semi final match between Germany and Italy at the National Stadium on June 28, 2012 in Warsaw, Poland. Mario Balotelli of Italy controls the ball as he runs through to score his team's second goal during the UEFA EURO 2012 semi final match between Germany and Italy Joern Pollex/Getty Images. (CBS News) The outspoken and often-temperamental Mario Balotelli was all smiles in Warsaw today as the Italian national team knocked Germany out of Euro 2012. The striker scored both of Italy's goals in a 2-1 semi-final match that was all but over by half-time. In the 20th minute of the first half, Italian forward Antonio Cassano managed to work the ball to the edge of Germany's penalty box.

title: Balotelli sends Italy past Germany to EURO 2012 final - UEFA.com
content: UEFA EURO - Balotelli sends Italy past Germany to EURO 2012 final - News. # Balotelli sends Italy past Germany to EURO 2012 final. Mario Balotelli struck twice as Italy once again proved Germany's nemesis, Cesare Prandelli's side holding on in Warsaw to set up a final against Spain. EURO 2012 highlights: Germany 1-2 Italy. Italy once again proved to be Germany's nemesis after Mario Balotelli struck two first-half goals to set up a UEFA EURO 2012 final against Spain on Sunday. Joachim Löw's side came into the semi-final full of confidence having swept all before them in Poland and Ukraine, but perhaps lingering at the back of their minds was the fact that Germany had never beaten the Azzurri in seven competitive meetings. Prandelli has described his side as a work in progress but, after surviving a nervous opening, they were soon looking like the finished article. Özil and Toni Kroos, on his first start of the tournament, tested Buffon again, but the Azzurri were looking the more dangerous side.
